title: Publish final gf2-core SOTA closure report
description:
Publish the final gf2-core SOTA closure report and presentation.

## Background

The epic should close with a single authoritative scorecard, raw CSVs, linked evidence, and a Reveal.js presentation summarizing achieved ratios and remaining non-goal boundaries.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Final raw CSVs and markdown scorecard cover every in-scope benchmark cell and reference owner.
- [hard] A Reveal.js presentation is linked to the epic and summarizes ratios, algorithms, no-go decisions, and future research.
- [hard] All child stories are done, gates pass, and the epic can serve as the SOTA checkpoint for b117c95e.
